dialogue.ja: ああ
dialogue.local: Oh

dialogue.text: Aahhh...
dialogue.zh: 啊啊啊...
dialogue.ja: あああ...
dialogue.local: Aahhh...
dialogue.en: Aahhh...

dialogue.text: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.zh: 兩千多年前，古代中國學者觀察了自然界的變化模式，氣候、季節的更替以及天文現象。
dialogue.ja: 2000年以上前、古代の中国の学者たちは自然界の変化、気候、季節の移り変わり、天文学を観察しました。
dialogue.local: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.
dialogue.en: Over 2000 years ago, ancient Chinese scholars observed the changing patterns in our natural world, the climate, the turning of the seasons and astronomy.

dialogue.text: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old parts, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.zh: 學者們測量並將太陽的年度運行分為24個部分，創造了二十四節氣，這些節氣用來指導古代中國的農業。
dialogue.ja: 学者たちは太陽の年間の動きを24の部分に分け、二十四節気を作り、古代中国の農業を管理するために使いました。
dialogue.local: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old parts, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.
dialogue.en: The scholars measured and divided the sun's annual movements into 24-year-old parts, creating the 24 solar terms, which were used to govern agriculture in ancient China.

dialogue.text: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.zh: 直到今天，這項發明仍然指導著數億中國人的生活和傳統。
dialogue.ja: 今日に至るまで、この発明は何億もの中国人の生活や伝統を導いています。
dialogue.local: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.
dialogue.en: Even to this day, this invention still guides the lives and traditions of hundreds of millions of Chinese people.

dialogue.text: At around August 23, the 14th solar term, the end of heat comes.
dialogue.zh: 大約在8月23日，十四節氣中的『處暑』到來。
dialogue.ja: 8月23日頃、14番目の節気である「処暑」が訪れます。
dialogue.local: At around August 23, the 14th solar term, the end of heat comes.
dialogue.en: At around August 23, the 14th solar term, the end of heat comes.

dialogue.text: It means that the summer heat is over.
dialogue.zh: 這代表夏季的炎熱結束了。
dialogue.ja: これは夏の暑さが終わったことを意味します。
dialogue.local: It means that the summer heat is over.
dialogue.en: It means that the summer heat is over.

dialogue.text: This is the best harvest season for the farmland, and it's also a time for giving thanks of blessings received, and a season for remembering the deposit.
dialogue.zh: 這是農田最好的收穫季節，也是感謝所獲祝福的時刻，並且是回憶過去的季節。
dialogue.ja: これは農作物の最良の収穫期であり、受けた恵みに感謝し、過去を振り返る季節でもあります。
dialogue.local: This is the best harvest season for the farmland, and it's also a time for giving thanks of blessings received, and a season for remembering the deposit.
dialogue.en: This is the best harvest season for the farmland, and it's also a time for giving thanks of blessings received, and a season for remembering the deposit.

dialogue.text: Whether heat wave of summer passes, Mother Nature turns to autumn.
dialogue.zh: 夏季的熱浪過去後，大自然轉向秋天。
dialogue.ja: 夏の熱波が過ぎ去ると、自然は秋へと移り変わります。
dialogue.local: Whether heat wave of summer passes, Mother Nature turns to autumn.
dialogue.en: Whether heat wave of summer passes, Mother Nature turns to autumn.

dialogue.text: The end of heat solar term has officially begun, and the temperature drops fast.
dialogue.zh: 處暑節氣正式開始，氣溫迅速下降。
dialogue.ja: 処暑の節気が正式に始まり、気温が急速に下がります。
dialogue.local: The end of heat solar term has officially begun, and the temperature drops fast.
dialogue.en: The end of heat solar term has officially begun, and the temperature drops fast.

dialogue.text: Yunnan is one of the most ethnically diverse regions in China.
dialogue.zh: 雲南是中國民族最多元的地區之一。
dialogue.ja: 雲南は中国で最も民族が多様な地域の一つです。
dialogue.local: Yunnan is one of the most ethnically diverse regions in China.
dialogue.en: Yunnan is one of the most ethnically diverse regions in China.

dialogue.text: Dali, on the beautiful Arhai lake, has been inhabited for generations by the pine minority.
dialogue.zh: 大理位於美麗的洱海湖畔，世代居住著彝族少數民族。
dialogue.ja: 大理は美しい洱海のほとりにあり、代々彝族の人々が住んでいます。
dialogue.local: Dali, on the beautiful Arhai lake, has been inhabited for generations by the pine minority.
dialogue.en: Dali, on the beautiful Arhai lake, has been inhabited for generations by the pine minority.

dialogue.text: They come from here, and most live nearby.
dialogue.zh: 他們來自這裡，大多數人住在附近。
dialogue.ja: 彼らはここから来ており、ほとんどが近くに住んでいます。
dialogue.local: They come from here, and most live nearby.
dialogue.en: They come from here, and most live nearby.

dialogue.text: For the by, the end of heat solar term is very important.
dialogue.zh: 對彝族來說，處暑節氣非常重要。
dialogue.ja: 彝族にとって、処暑の節気はとても重要です。
dialogue.local: For the by, the end of heat solar term is very important.
dialogue.en: For the by, the end of heat solar term is very important.

dialogue.text: For its signals that the crops are ready to harvest.
dialogue.zh: 因為這代表作物已經成熟可以收割。
dialogue.ja: それは作物が収穫の時期であることを知らせるからです。
dialogue.local: For its signals that the crops are ready to harvest.
dialogue.en: For its signals that the crops are ready to harvest.

dialogue.text: And one plant above all is treasured by the bype, when it ripens, the people get ready to celebrate.
dialogue.zh: 其中一種植物是彝族最珍惜的，當它成熟時，人們準備慶祝。
dialogue.ja: そして何よりも大切にされている植物があり、それが熟すと人々は祝う準備をします。
dialogue.local: And one plant above all is treasured by the bype, when it ripens, the people get ready to celebrate.
dialogue.en: And one plant above all is treasured by the bype, when it ripens, the people get ready to celebrate.

dialogue.text: While most of China is changing, from the lush greens of summer to the golden tints of autumn, here the indigo plant has matured, and people come out to greet its fields of blue.
dialogue.zh: 當中國大部分地區從夏季的翠綠轉為秋季的金黃時，這裡的靛藍植物已經成熟，人們走出來迎接藍色的田野。
dialogue.ja: 中国の多くの地域が夏の緑から秋の黄金色に変わる中、ここでは藍の植物が成熟し、人々は青い畑を迎えに出てきます。
dialogue.local: While most of China is changing, from the lush greens of summer to the golden tints of autumn, here the indigo plant has matured, and people come out to greet its fields of blue.
dialogue.en: While most of China is changing, from the lush greens of summer to the golden tints of autumn, here the indigo plant has matured, and people come out to greet its fields of blue.

dialogue.text: By the Neolithic era, the Chinese had already discovered how to extract dyes from seasonal flowers and fruits.
dialogue.zh: 早在新石器時代，中國人已經發現如何從季節性的花果中提取染料。
dialogue.ja: 新石器時代には、中国人は季節の花や果物から染料を抽出する方法を発見していました。
dialogue.local: By the Neolithic era, the Chinese had already discovered how to extract dyes from seasonal flowers and fruits.
dialogue.en: By the Neolithic era, the Chinese had already discovered how to extract dyes from seasonal flowers and fruits.

dialogue.text: The chosen color of the bype is the blue of the end of heat solar term.
dialogue.zh: 彝族選擇的顏色是處暑節氣的藍色。
dialogue.ja: 彝族が選んだ色は処暑の節気の青色です。
dialogue.local: The chosen color of the bype is the blue of the end of heat solar term.
dialogue.en: The chosen color of the bype is the blue of the end of heat solar term.

dialogue.text: Duan shuquan is one of the guardians of the bype Haidai.
dialogue.zh: 段樹泉是彝族靛藍染的守護者之一。
dialogue.ja: 段樹泉は彝族の藍染の守護者の一人です。
dialogue.local: Duan shuquan is one of the guardians of the bype Haidai.
dialogue.en: Duan shuquan is one of the guardians of the bype Haidai.

dialogue.text: The indigo plant is known in traditional Chinese medicine for being good for preventing colds.
dialogue.zh: 靛藍植物在中醫中被認為有預防感冒的功效。
dialogue.ja: 藍の植物は伝統中国医学で風邪の予防に良いとされています。
dialogue.local: The indigo plant is known in traditional Chinese medicine for being good for preventing colds.
dialogue.en: The indigo plant is known in traditional Chinese medicine for being good for preventing colds.

dialogue.text: But over a thousand years ago, the bype would dye cloth with it.
dialogue.zh: 但一千多年前，彝族就用它來染布。
dialogue.ja: しかし1000年以上前から、彝族はそれを使って布を染めていました。
dialogue.local: But over a thousand years ago, the bype would dye cloth with it.
dialogue.en: But over a thousand years ago, the bype would dye cloth with it.

dialogue.text: They invented the art of taidai, and have handed it down over generations.
dialogue.zh: 他們發明了扎染藝術，並世代相傳。
dialogue.ja: 彼らは藍染の技術を発明し、世代を超えて受け継いできました。
dialogue.local: They invented the art of taidai, and have handed it down over generations.
dialogue.en: They invented the art of taidai, and have handed it down over generations.

dialogue.text: This is another piece of those I've used today at the beginning in Czech well.
dialogue.zh: 這是我今天一開始在澤克井使用的另一塊布。
dialogue.ja: これは今日最初にチェコの井戸で使った別の布です。
dialogue.local: This is another piece of those I've used today at the beginning in Czech well.
dialogue.en: This is another piece of those I've used today at the beginning in Czech well.

dialogue.text: This is oneANAT.
dialogue.zh: 這是一塊布。
dialogue.ja: これは一枚の布です。
dialogue.local: This is oneANAT.
dialogue.en: This is oneANAT.

dialogue.text: This is the name of the G.
dialogue.zh: 這是G的名字。
dialogue.ja: これはGの名前です。
dialogue.local: This is the name of the G.
dialogue.en: This is the name of the G.

dialogue.text: Chinese is different, usually large and so good energy.
dialogue.zh: 中國的布料不同，通常較大且充滿活力。
dialogue.ja: 中国の布は異なり、通常は大きくてエネルギーに満ちています。
dialogue.local: Chinese is different, usually large and so good energy.
dialogue.en: Chinese is different, usually large and so good energy.

dialogue.text: So the blue and the white of indigo tie-dye represents what is pure open and correct.
dialogue.zh: 因此，靛藍扎染的藍與白代表純潔、開放和正直。
dialogue.ja: だから藍染の青と白は純粋さ、開放さ、正しさを表しています。
dialogue.local: So the blue and the white of indigo tie-dye represents what is pure open and correct.
dialogue.en: So the blue and the white of indigo tie-dye represents what is pure open and correct.

dialogue.text: This is how the buy look at colors.
dialogue.zh: 這就是彝族看待顏色的方式。
dialogue.ja: これが彝族の色の見方です。
dialogue.local: This is how the buy look at colors.
dialogue.en: This is how the buy look at colors.

dialogue.text: In 2015, one shoe point converted an all-tie-dye factory into the first museum dedicated to buy tie-dye in China.
dialogue.zh: 2015年，某個鞋點將一家全扎染工廠改建成中國第一個專門展示彝族扎染的博物館。
dialogue.ja: 2015年、ある場所が全ての藍染工場を中国初の彝族藍染博物館に改装しました。
dialogue.local: In 2015, one shoe point converted an all-tie-dye factory into the first museum dedicated to buy tie-dye in China.
dialogue.en: In 2015, one shoe point converted an all-tie-dye factory into the first museum dedicated to buy tie-dye in China.

dialogue.text: By tie-dye is so beautifully blue and this is down to indigo.
dialogue.zh: 彝族扎染呈現出如此美麗的藍色，這全靠靛藍。
dialogue.ja: 彝族の藍染はとても美しい青色で、それは藍のおかげです。
dialogue.local: By tie-dye is so beautifully blue and this is down to indigo.
dialogue.en: By tie-dye is so beautifully blue and this is down to indigo.

dialogue.text: Every end of heat solar term after harvesting and picking indigo leaves, the mature stems and leaves are collected in a pine container mixed with water and lime and soaked.
dialogue.zh: 每年處暑節氣後，收割並採摘靛藍葉，將成熟的莖葉放入松木容器中，加入水和石灰浸泡。
dialogue.ja: 毎年処暑の節気の後、藍の葉を収穫し、成熟した茎や葉を松の容器に入れ、水と石灰と混ぜて浸します。
dialogue.local: Every end of heat solar term after harvesting and picking indigo leaves, the mature stems and leaves are collected in a pine container mixed with water and lime and soaked.
dialogue.en: Every end of heat solar term after harvesting and picking indigo leaves, the mature stems and leaves are collected in a pine container mixed with water and lime and soaked.

dialogue.text: They slowly ferment into a blue green solution leaving a sediment behind.
dialogue.zh: 它們慢慢發酵成藍綠色的溶液，留下沉澱物。
dialogue.ja: それらはゆっくりと発酵して青緑色の液体になり、沈殿物を残します。
dialogue.local: They slowly ferment into a blue green solution leaving a sediment behind.
dialogue.en: They slowly ferment into a blue green solution leaving a sediment behind.

dialogue.text: After the water evaporates, the tie-dye paste is ready and the artistic journey begins.
dialogue.zh: 水分蒸發後，扎染膏準備好了，藝術的旅程開始了。
dialogue.ja: 水が蒸発すると、藍染のペーストが完成し、芸術の旅が始まります。
dialogue.local: After the water evaporates, the tie-dye paste is ready and the artistic journey begins.
dialogue.en: After the water evaporates, the tie-dye paste is ready and the artistic journey begins.

dialogue.text: Previously, drawings were made directly onto the cloth but this was time-consuming and hard to reproduce.
dialogue.zh: 以前，圖案是直接畫在布上，但這既費時又難以複製。
dialogue.ja: 以前は布に直接絵を描いていましたが、時間がかかり再現が難しかったです。
dialogue.local: Previously, drawings were made directly onto the cloth but this was time-consuming and hard to reproduce.
dialogue.en: Previously, drawings were made directly onto the cloth but this was time-consuming and hard to reproduce.

dialogue.text: In order to expand production, drawing shoe point learnt how to make templates.
dialogue.zh: 為了擴大生產，繪圖鞋點學會了製作模板。
dialogue.ja: 生産を拡大するために、描画の技術者は型紙の作り方を学びました。
dialogue.local: In order to expand production, drawing shoe point learnt how to make templates.
dialogue.en: In order to expand production, drawing shoe point learnt how to make templates.

dialogue.text: There it is.
dialogue.zh: 就是這個。
dialogue.ja: これです。
dialogue.local: There it is.
dialogue.en: There it is.

dialogue.text: Beautiful butterfly.
dialogue.zh: 美麗的蝴蝶。
dialogue.ja: 美しい蝶です。
dialogue.local: Beautiful butterfly.
dialogue.en: Beautiful butterfly.

dialogue.text: Here it is.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡。
dialogue.ja: ここにあります。
dialogue.local: Here it is.
dialogue.en: Here it is.

dialogue.text: Indigo paste goes through the holes in the template and seeps into the cloth, giving it to the mark of buy tie-dye.
dialogue.zh: 靛藍膏透過模板的孔洞滲入布料，形成彝族扎染的標記。
dialogue.ja: 藍のペーストは型紙の穴を通って布に染み込み、彝族の藍染の印をつけます。
dialogue.local: Indigo paste goes through the holes in the template and seeps into the cloth, giving it to the mark of buy tie-dye.
dialogue.en: Indigo paste goes through the holes in the template and seeps into the cloth, giving it to the mark of buy tie-dye.

dialogue.text: But for what we call tie-dye, first tying and then dyeing, the second step is the core of the handicraft.
dialogue.zh: 但我們所說的扎染，是先綁紮再染色，第二步是手工藝的核心。
dialogue.ja: しかし私たちが藍染と呼ぶものは、まず縛ってから染めることで、二番目の工程が手工芸の核心です。
dialogue.local: But for what we call tie-dye, first tying and then dyeing, the second step is the core of the handicraft.
dialogue.en: But for what we call tie-dye, first tying and then dyeing, the second step is the core of the handicraft.

dialogue.text: Tying patterns and is mostly done by eye women.
dialogue.zh: 綁紮圖案主要由婦女憑眼力完成。
dialogue.ja: 縛る模様は主に女性が目で見て行います。
dialogue.local: Tying patterns and is mostly done by eye women.
dialogue.en: Tying patterns and is mostly done by eye women.

dialogue.text: This is the first tie-dye.
dialogue.zh: 這是第一次扎染。
dialogue.ja: これが最初の藍染です。
dialogue.local: This is the first tie-dye.
dialogue.en: This is the first tie-dye.

dialogue.text: Tying patterns are the core skill of tie-dye.
dialogue.zh: 綁紮圖案是扎染的核心技藝。
dialogue.ja: 縛る模様は藍染の核心技術です。
dialogue.local: Tying patterns are the core skill of tie-dye.
dialogue.en: Tying patterns are the core skill of tie-dye.

dialogue.text: Determining the pattern and colour of the finished piece is central.
dialogue.zh: 決定成品的圖案和顏色是關鍵。
dialogue.ja: 完成品の模様と色を決めることが重要です。
dialogue.local: Determining the pattern and colour of the finished piece is central.
dialogue.en: Determining the pattern and colour of the finished piece is central.

dialogue.text: Afterwards the process of dyeing is the most secretive step.
dialogue.zh: 接著染色過程是最神秘的步驟。
dialogue.ja: その後の染色工程は最も秘密にされています。
dialogue.local: Afterwards the process of dyeing is the most secretive step.
dialogue.en: Afterwards the process of dyeing is the most secretive step.

dialogue.text: According to buy tradition, dyes are made according to secret recipes and never given to outsiders.
dialogue.zh: 根據彝族傳統，染料是依照秘密配方製作，絕不外傳。
dialogue.ja: 彝族の伝統によると、染料は秘密のレシピで作られ、外部には決して教えません。
dialogue.local: According to buy tradition, dyes are made according to secret recipes and never given to outsiders.
dialogue.en: According to buy tradition, dyes are made according to secret recipes and never given to outsiders.

dialogue.text: So, Mr. Dwayne only promised to teach me how to dye cloth using a pre-mixed dye solution.
dialogue.zh: 所以，段先生只答應教我如何使用預先調配的染料溶液染布。
dialogue.ja: だから段さんは、あらかじめ混ぜられた染料溶液を使って布を染める方法だけを教えてくれました。
dialogue.local: So, Mr. Dwayne only promised to teach me how to dye cloth using a pre-mixed dye solution.
dialogue.en: So, Mr. Dwayne only promised to teach me how to dye cloth using a pre-mixed dye solution.

dialogue.text: The charm of Taidai lies in the natural contrast between blue and white.
dialogue.zh: 扎染的魅力在於藍與白的自然對比。
dialogue.ja: 藍染の魅力は青と白の自然なコントラストにあります。
dialogue.local: The charm of Taidai lies in the natural contrast between blue and white.
dialogue.en: The charm of Taidai lies in the natural contrast between blue and white.

dialogue.text: It is precisely the looseness or tightness of the stitching that influences the variety, making every piece unique.
dialogue.zh: 正是縫紉的鬆緊程度影響了圖案的多樣性，使每件作品獨一無二。
dialogue.ja: 縫い目のゆるさやきつさが多様性に影響し、すべての作品をユニークにしています。
dialogue.local: It is precisely the looseness or tightness of the stitching that influences the variety, making every piece unique.
dialogue.en: It is precisely the looseness or tightness of the stitching that influences the variety, making every piece unique.

dialogue.text: It is this uniqueness that brings in the tourists and their wants.
dialogue.zh: 正是這種獨特性吸引了遊客和他們的需求。
dialogue.ja: この独自性が観光客とそのニーズを引き寄せます。
dialogue.local: It is this uniqueness that brings in the tourists and their wants.
dialogue.en: It is this uniqueness that brings in the tourists and their wants.

dialogue.text: The ancient Chinese said that the clouds are crazy in July and August.
dialogue.zh: 古代中國人說七八月的雲彩很瘋狂。
dialogue.ja: 古代の中国人は7月と8月の雲は狂っていると言いました。
dialogue.local: The ancient Chinese said that the clouds are crazy in July and August.
dialogue.en: The ancient Chinese said that the clouds are crazy in July and August.

dialogue.text: In Dali, drawing end of heat solar term, they really blow your mind.
dialogue.zh: 在大理，處暑節氣的雲彩真的令人驚嘆。
dialogue.ja: 大理では、処暑の節気の雲は本当に驚かされます。
dialogue.local: In Dali, drawing end of heat solar term, they really blow your mind.
dialogue.en: In Dali, drawing end of heat solar term, they really blow your mind.

dialogue.text: Dali is a utopia to Chinese people, with five villages pressed between Tang Mountain and R.I. Lake.
dialogue.zh: 大理對中國人來說是一個烏托邦，五個村莊夾在唐山和洱海之間。
dialogue.ja: 大理は中国人にとってユートピアで、五つの村が唐山と洱海の間にあります。
dialogue.local: Dali is a utopia to Chinese people, with five villages pressed between Tang Mountain and R.I. Lake.
dialogue.en: Dali is a utopia to Chinese people, with five villages pressed between Tang Mountain and R.I. Lake.

dialogue.text: The relaxed atmosphere attracts young people from all walks of life.
dialogue.zh: 輕鬆的氛圍吸引了各行各業的年輕人。
dialogue.ja: リラックスした雰囲気が様々な若者を惹きつけています。
dialogue.local: The relaxed atmosphere attracts young people from all walks of life.
dialogue.en: The relaxed atmosphere attracts young people from all walks of life.

dialogue.text: Today, Dali has grown from a small village into a broadening, creative town.
dialogue.zh: 如今，大理已從一個小村莊發展成一個日益擴大的創意城鎮。
dialogue.ja: 今日、大理は小さな村から広がりつつある創造的な町へと成長しました。
dialogue.local: Today, Dali has grown from a small village into a broadening, creative town.
dialogue.en: Today, Dali has grown from a small village into a broadening, creative town.

dialogue.text: Shall buy in her family are the new guardians of Daidai.
dialogue.zh: 彝族的沙買家族是扎染的新守護者。
dialogue.ja: 彝族のシャバイ一家は藍染の新しい守護者です。
dialogue.local: Shall buy in her family are the new guardians of Daidai.
dialogue.en: Shall buy in her family are the new guardians of Daidai.

dialogue.text: Shall buy in Dali, like many young people today, they left home for the big city to pursue their dreams.
dialogue.zh: 大理的沙買像許多年輕人一樣，離開家鄉到大城市追夢。
dialogue.ja: 大理のシャバイは多くの若者と同じように、夢を追って都会へ出ました。
dialogue.local: Shall buy in Dali, like many young people today, they left home for the big city to pursue their dreams.
dialogue.en: Shall buy in Dali, like many young people today, they left home for the big city to pursue their dreams.

dialogue.text: But in 2013, they chose to return home together to make Taidai's for a new generation.
dialogue.zh: 但在2013年，他們選擇一起回家，為新一代製作扎染。
dialogue.ja: しかし2013年、彼らは一緒に故郷に戻り、新世代のために藍染を作ることを選びました。
dialogue.local: But in 2013, they chose to return home together to make Taidai's for a new generation.
dialogue.en: But in 2013, they chose to return home together to make Taidai's for a new generation.

dialogue.text: In this century, all buy home, shall buy creates her own Taidai's.
dialogue.zh: 在這個世紀，沙買家創造了她自己的扎染作品。
dialogue.ja: この世紀に、シャバイは自分の藍染作品を作っています。
dialogue.local: In this century, all buy home, shall buy creates her own Taidai's.
dialogue.en: In this century, all buy home, shall buy creates her own Taidai's.

dialogue.text: Her goal is not only selling products, but also helping to ensure that traditional skills become better known to the public.
dialogue.zh: 她的目標不僅是銷售產品，也幫助讓傳統技藝更廣為人知。
dialogue.ja: 彼女の目標は製品を売るだけでなく、伝統技術をより多くの人に知ってもらうことです。
dialogue.local: Her goal is not only selling products, but also helping to ensure that traditional skills become better known to the public.
dialogue.en: Her goal is not only selling products, but also helping to ensure that traditional skills become better known to the public.

dialogue.text: She is helping people get in touch with nature, and enjoy a slower pace of life through Daidai's.
dialogue.zh: 她幫助人們接觸自然，並透過扎染享受慢活。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は人々が自然と触れ合い、藍染を通じてゆったりとした生活を楽しむ手助けをしています。
dialogue.local: She is helping people get in touch with nature, and enjoy a slower pace of life through Daidai's.
dialogue.en: She is helping people get in touch with nature, and enjoy a slower pace of life through Daidai's.

dialogue.text: Quite the hippie lifestyle one could say.
dialogue.zh: 可以說是一種嬉皮士的生活方式。
dialogue.ja: いわゆるヒッピーのライフスタイルと言えるでしょう。
dialogue.local: Quite the hippie lifestyle one could say.
dialogue.en: Quite the hippie lifestyle one could say.

dialogue.text: Her creativity made blankets, but Xiaobai uses ancient dying methods.
dialogue.zh: 她的創意製作了毯子，但小白使用古老的染色方法。
dialogue.ja: 彼女の創造性は毛布を作り、小白は古代の染色方法を使っています。
dialogue.local: Her creativity made blankets, but Xiaobai uses ancient dying methods.
dialogue.en: Her creativity made blankets, but Xiaobai uses ancient dying methods.

dialogue.text: The dyes are all derived from plants, and this natural connection inspires people.
dialogue.zh: 染料全部來自植物，這種自然的連結激發人們靈感。
dialogue.ja: 染料はすべて植物由来で、この自然とのつながりが人々にインスピレーションを与えます。
dialogue.local: The dyes are all derived from plants, and this natural connection inspires people.
dialogue.en: The dyes are all derived from plants, and this natural connection inspires people.

dialogue.text: In the afternoon, Xiaobai welcomes guests from afar into her courtyard.
dialogue.zh: 下午，小白歡迎遠方的客人來到她的院子。
dialogue.ja: 午後、小白は遠くから来た客を自分の庭に迎え入れます。
dialogue.local: In the afternoon, Xiaobai welcomes guests from a fire into her courtyard.
dialogue.en: In the afternoon, Xiaobai welcomes guests from a fire into her courtyard.

dialogue.text: Accompanied by parents, children learn about tie-dye and begin to care about plants and learn about the beauty of the plant world.
dialogue.zh: 在父母陪同下，孩子們學習扎染，開始關心植物並了解植物世界的美麗。
dialogue.ja: 親に付き添われて、子供たちは藍染について学び、植物に関心を持ち、植物の美しさを知ります。
dialogue.local: Accompanied by parents, children learn about tie-dang and begin to care about plants and learn about the beauty of the plant world.
dialogue.en: Accompanied by parents, children learn about tie-dang and begin to care about plants and learn about the beauty of the plant world.

dialogue.text: Very good!
dialogue.zh: 非常好！
dialogue.ja: とても良い！
dialogue.local: Very good!
dialogue.en: Very good!

dialogue.text: No, it works, but it works!
dialogue.zh: 不，這有效，真的有效！
dialogue.ja: いいえ、うまくいきます、本当にうまくいきます！
dialogue.local: No, it works, but it works!
dialogue.en: No, it works, but it works!

dialogue.text: Science is taking the entire proportion all day time.
dialogue.zh: 科學整天都在進行。
dialogue.ja: 科学は一日中その割合を占めています。
dialogue.local: Science is taking the entire proportion all day time.
dialogue.en: Science is taking the entire proportion all day time.

dialogue.text: The work of the Dolphin was never about getting there.
dialogue.zh: 海豚的工作從來不是為了到達那裡。
dialogue.ja: イルカの仕事はそこに到達することではありませんでした。
dialogue.local: The work of the Dolphin was never about getting there.
dialogue.en: The work of the Dolphin was never about getting there.

dialogue.text: We are a fantastic teacher, we need to learn about the history and the HGU Nathan.
dialogue.zh: 我們是很棒的老師，我們需要學習歷史和HGU Nathan。
dialogue.ja: 私たちは素晴らしい教師であり、歴史とHGUネイサンについて学ぶ必要があります。
dialogue.local: We are a fantastic teacher, we need to learn about the history and the HGU Nathan.
dialogue.en: We are a fantastic teacher, we need to learn about the history and the HGU Nathan.

dialogue.text: We will give you a boy following you.
dialogue.zh: 我們會給你一個男孩跟隨你。
dialogue.ja: 私たちはあなたに男の子をつけます。
dialogue.local: We will give you a boy following you.
dialogue.en: We will give you a boy following you.

dialogue.text: No, we won't.
dialogue.zh: 不，我們不會。
dialogue.ja: いいえ、しません。
dialogue.local: No, we won't.
dialogue.en: No, we won't.

dialogue.text: Now I'm going to see a Flying
dialogue.zh: 現在我要去看飛翔。
dialogue.ja: 今から飛んでいるものを見に行きます。
dialogue.local: Now I'm going to see a Flying
dialogue.en: Now I'm going to see a Flying

dialogue.text: Ciao by said that her childhood was…
dialogue.zh: 小白說她的童年是……
dialogue.ja: シャオバイは子供時代について話しました…
dialogue.local: Ciao by said that her childhood was…
dialogue.en: Ciao by said that her childhood was…

dialogue.text: about blue, blue cloth floating under the blue sky. That's the color of Dali, and it's close to the blind people's hearts.
dialogue.zh: 關於藍色，藍色的布在藍天之下飄動。那是大理的顏色，也貼近彝族人的心。
dialogue.ja: 青い、青い布が青空の下で漂う。それが大理の色であり、彝族の人々の心に近いのです。
dialogue.local: about blue, blue cloth floating under the blue sky. That's the color of Dali, and it's close to the blind people's hearts.
dialogue.en: about blue, blue cloth floating under the blue sky. That's the color of Dali, and it's close to the blind people's hearts.

dialogue.text: She wants to pass the memory on through her efforts and with those of her family.
dialogue.zh: 她希望透過自己的努力和家人的幫助將這份記憶傳承下去。
dialogue.ja: 彼女は自分と家族の努力でその記憶を伝えたいと思っています。
dialogue.local: She wants to pass the memory on through her efforts and with those of her family.
dialogue.en: She wants to pass the memory on through her efforts and with those of her family.

dialogue.text: Strolling away from Xiaobai's house, pass the bent heads of by women tying their patterns.
dialogue.zh: 離開小白的家，經過彝族婦女低頭綁紮圖案。
dialogue.ja: シャオバイの家を離れて歩くと、彝族の女性たちが模様を縛っている姿が見えます。
dialogue.local: Strolling away from Xiaobai's house, pass the bent heads of by women tying their patterns.
dialogue.en: Strolling away from Xiaobai's house, pass the bent heads of by women tying their patterns.

dialogue.text: The sweat and hard work of craftspeople bring the craft to life.
dialogue.zh: 工匠們的汗水和努力讓這項工藝充滿生命。
dialogue.ja: 職人たちの汗と努力がこの技術に命を吹き込みます。
dialogue.local: The sweat and hard work of craftspeople bring the craft to life.
dialogue.en: The sweat and hard work of craftspeople bring the craft to life.

dialogue.text: And the blue borrowed from nature becomes real with the indigo harvest of the end of heat solar term.
dialogue.zh: 從大自然借來的藍色，隨著處暑節氣的靛藍收成變得真實。
dialogue.ja: 自然から借りた青は、処暑の節気の藍の収穫で現実のものになります。
dialogue.local: And the blue borrowed from nature becomes real with the indigo harvest of the end of heat solar term.
dialogue.en: And the blue borrowed from nature becomes real with the indigo harvest of the end of heat solar term.

dialogue.text: This is a blue that the by people have no intention of washing off.
dialogue.zh: 這是彝族人不打算洗掉的藍色。
dialogue.ja: これは彝族の人々が洗い流すつもりのない青です。
dialogue.local: This is a blue that the by people have no intention of washing off.
dialogue.en: This is a blue that the by people have no intention of washing off.
